Title: Kunal and the Family

Cast

1. Kunal - 12 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Meenakshi - 40 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Savitri - 72 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses
4. Siya - 9 years, friend
Look: yellow frock, two plaits

Places

1. The bathroom - a tap, a bucket, a mirror
2. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The bathroom - Day

[Kunal stands in the bathroom. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Meenakshi: "What's the plan today?"

[Kunal brushes his teeth at the sink.]

Kunal: "Hey, look at that!"

[Kunal takes a quick bath.]

Kunal (laughing): "One more time!"

Scene 2: The snowy hillside - Day

[Kunal stands in the snow. Meenakshi and Savitri stand near him.]

Kunal: "Grandma, look over here."

[Snow starts to fall.]

Kunal: "Hmm, I see."

[Kunal builds a snowman.]

Meenakshi (excited): "Okay, Mother."

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Kunal stands in the living room. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Meenakshi: "Kunal, look over here."

[Kunal eats his breakfast at the table.]

Kunal (excited): "Mom, are you okay?"

[Kunal takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Kunal: "Mom, listen!"

[Kunal munches on an apple.]

Meenakshi (softly): "Yes, all right."

[Kunal drinks a glass of water.]

Meenakshi (laughing): "Really?"

[Kunal sips hot tea from a cup.]

Meenakshi (softly): "Really?"

[Kunal gulps down a glass of milk.]

Meenakshi: "What happened?"

[Kunal serves hot rotis to Mother.]

Meenakshi: "I really enjoyed today."
